audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows contradict the page's own why-text: rows 0-3 read Skill/Vladimir/Vladimir/Skill while whys[0..3] all describe Lucian bullying you, and row 4 reads Skill while whys[4] says you counter The Culling and win the trade.
audit.why: The packet chart is Lucian for rows 0-3 and Vladimir for rows 4-6, matching the prose row for row. Vladimir does not win Levels 2-3 against a ranged marksman with a dash.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3 flipped to Lucian and row 4 to Vladimir, as five matched full/content pairs in one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero sequencing cues, and the one number the page does give is wrong: spikes[2] calls Relentless Pursuit 'a single dash on ~10s+ cooldown early'.
audit.why: It is 16s at rank 1 and only falls to 14s at rank 5 — considerably longer than the page implies, which makes the post-dash window much bigger than a reader would expect. The Culling is 110s at rank 1, near enough to Hemoplague's 120s that the two ultimates trade one-for-one.
audit.corrected: 16s written into spikes[2].text, dosFull[0].d, tldr and the cooldown block; 110s written into spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to track Relentless Pursuit as a fixed cooldown, but never mentions the mechanic that governs it — Lightslinger attacks reduce its cooldown.
audit.why: Counting seconds gives the wrong answer whenever he is hitting you: his double-shots pull the dash forward, so the escape can be back well before a 16s clock says it should be. That is the difference between a committed dive and a wasted one.
audit.corrected: The cooldown-reduction mechanic stated in dosFull[0].d and the cooldown block, with the instruction to count his attacks rather than seconds.

audit.why: The _missing file lists 'needs-antiheal — Lucian sustains through chip damage (Lightslinger)'. That is a derived-flag misfire. Riot's passive text says Lucian gains bonus magic damage when he is healed or shielded BY AN ALLY — the passive does no healing of its own, and in a solo top lane there is no ally to trigger it. I did not write an anti-heal line.
audit.corrected: No change; recorded here so the same false positive is not chased again.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Use Relentless Pursuit' in wants.foe[1] as a probable wrong name. False positive — Relentless Pursuit is Lucian's real E name.

edits.before: Weather the poke — drain him down and pool the Relentless Pursuit answer. Vladimir wins the Relentless Pursuit cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather levels 1-4 — then Pool the Culling and drain him down; Relentless Pursuit is 16s, so his exit is not always there.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Relentless Pursuit: 16s at rank 1 — but every Lightslinger double-shot shortens it, so it returns faster in a fight. - Piercing Light: 9s, 500 range. - The Culling: 110s. - Pool: 28s, spent on his R.

edits.before: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1, but his double-shots cut it — count attacks, not seconds.

edits.before: Hemoplague is your equaliser but doesn't win the level outright — Lucian's Culling still out-DPSes you in a straight fight if he's healthy. Use R only as a counter-all-in: if he E's in aggressively, pool the Culling channel and detonate Hemoplague as he's committed and low on dashes.
edits.after: Hemoplague is your equaliser but doesn't win the level outright — The Culling is 110s and still out-DPSes you if he is healthy. Use R as a counter-all-in: when he dashes in, blank the channel with Pool's 2 untargetable seconds, then detonate Hemoplague on the committed target.

edits.before: The lane inverts here. With Rylai's plus your first AP item your Q sustain undoes his poke and your E stacking finally lands because his E is a single dash on ~10s+ cooldown early. Slow him with Rylai's, stack E, and he can't kite the way he did at level 3.
edits.after: The lane inverts here. With Rylai's plus your first AP item your Q sustain undoes his poke, and Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 — long enough that a slow keeps him inside your 600 range. Slow him, stack Tides of Blood, and he cannot kite the way he did at 3.

notes: Following the mirror, I wrote only that Pool blanks The Culling's channel rather than claiming it removes shots already in flight — that distinction is not resolvable from the kit data. The needs-antiheal entry in _missing for this matchup is a false positive worth recording: Lightslinger's heal flag comes from 'when Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally', which never fires in a solo lane. If that rule is generated from flags rather than text it will be producing the same bad hint on every Lucian matchup in the repo.
